svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 800" width="1280" height="800" font-family="Carlito, Arial, sans-serif" style="background:var(--bg)"><rect width="1280" height="800" fill="var(--bg)"/><text x="80" y="120" font-size="26" font-weight="700" fill="var(--muted)" text-anchor="start">Distance, 200 M</text><rect x="80.0" y="140" width="840.0" height="80" fill="#e8231a"/><rect x="920.0" y="140" width="280.0" height="80" fill="var(--accent)"/><text x="500.0" y="192" font-size="28" font-weight="700" fill="#fff" text-anchor="middle">150 M at 15 kn · 10 h</text><text x="1060.0" y="192" font-size="26" font-weight="700" fill="#fff" text-anchor="middle">50 M at 8 kn</text><text x="80" y="300" font-size="26" font-weight="700" fill="var(--muted)" text-anchor="start">Fuel, 1800 l usable</text><rect x="80.0" y="320" width="933.3" height="80" fill="#e8231a" opacity=".85"/><rect x="1013.3" y="320" width="186.7" height="80" fill="var(--accent)" opacity=".85"/><text x="546.7" y="372" font-size="28" font-weight="700" fill="#fff" text-anchor="middle">150 l/h × 10 h = 1500 l</text><text x="1106.7" y="372" font-size="26" font-weight="700" fill="#fff" text-anchor="middle">300 l</text><rect x="335.3" y="457.9" width="609.4" height="44.2" rx="22.1" fill="#e8231a" stroke="#e8231a" stroke-width="3"/><text x="640" y="489.4" font-size="26" font-weight="700" fill="#fff" text-anchor="middle">all at 15 kn: 1800 l lasts 12 h, 180 M</text><rect x="0" y="656" width="1280" height="144" fill="var(--band)"/><text x="30" y="696" font-size="30" font-weight="700" fill="var(--ink)" text-anchor="start">Fast first, then slow</text><text x="30" y="736" font-size="27" font-weight="400" fill="var(--ink)" text-anchor="start">· x h at 15 kn: 150x + 48 × (200 − 15x) ÷ 8 = 1800, so x = 10 h</text><text x="30" y="776" font-size="27" font-weight="400" fill="var(--ink)" text-anchor="start">· 150 M fast with 1500 l, then 50 M at 8 kn with 300 l: arrive on the reserve</text></svg>
